name: Porto Orff Orchestra 40th Anniversary
description: Celebrate four decades of this unique orchestra, known for its engaging and educational approach to music, in a special anniversary performance.
longDescription:
The Porto Orff Orchestra marks its 40th anniversary with a special performance at Sala 2, Casa da Música, on July 4, 2026. This unique musical ensemble is celebrated for its distinctive approach to music-making, rooted in the Orff Schulwerk methodology. The orchestra's long-standing presence in Porto reflects its commitment to fostering musical engagement and education through its performances.

Attendees can expect a performance showcasing the orchestra's four decades of work. The atmosphere will likely be celebratory, reflecting the significance of the anniversary. Sala 2 at Casa da Música provides an intimate setting for this musical event. The performance is suitable for a broad audience interested in orchestral music and the Orff approach.

Tickets for this event vary in price. Casa da Música is conveniently located and accessible via public transport; the Casa da Música metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F) is directly adjacent to the venue. The venue is generally accessible.
